reviews.title: scam
reviews.text: I downloaded this app while on a train and was curious how fast it was. The app does not have any functionality without paying for a subscription and I agreed to a free trial to see my speed. The app showed 0 speed and did not work for me, and I deleted it immediately. A few days later I saw a charge for ~21$ and realized that I forgot to cancel, as subscriptions stay even if you delete the associated app. I put in a refund request to Apple less than a week after downloading the app where it was denied and so was my appeal to that decision. When I called Apple Customer Support they told me a refund was not possible due to the policies of the app. Absolutely disgusting stealing money from a poor college student.

reviews.text: I was scammed into being charged $20 for this app. I agreed to a free version of this app and somehow the app forced me into a paid subscription charging me $20 that I NEVER agreed to. I tried to dispute this charge with Apple twice and they said “we reviewed your claim and your purchase doesn’t meet conditions for a refund”. Under subscriptions, it clearly shows I do not have an active subscription with this app, and I’m afraid they’ll try to charge me again in a year. Now I have to get Apple support on the phone.
